title: Recommendation V2 Evaluation

item_cold_start.rule: sha1(book_id) % 10 == 0; all their interactions before the test cutoff removed from features (targets unchanged). zero_evidence = popularity/CF/recency left at 0; neutral_imputation = those features set to the mean of the reader's other candidates; new_arrival_slot = additionally the best-scoring new title is guaranteed one of the top-10 places (production policy: both)

head_vs_tail_targets.head_definition: top 23 books by train loan count

acceptance.rule: V2 - baseline > 0 with paired 95% bootstrap CI above zero, for NDCG@10, Recall@10 and MRR, against V1_PRODUCTION and POPULARITY

conclusion: V2 closes 94.1% of the NDCG@10 gap between POPULARITY and the latent-truth ORACLE ceiling.
Ablation (NDCG@10, paired CI): removing collaborative, preference significantly hurts; popularity, quality, availability, recency show no significant effect; removing semantic would help.

Item cold start: Recall@10 on masked new books - V2 with imputation + new-arrival slot 0.1694, imputation only 0.0196, zero evidence 0.0, POPULARITY 0.0, RANDOM 0.1122 (V2 when their history is known: 0.6531).
Cold start, new users (n=58): NDCG@10 V2 0.4324 vs POPULARITY 0.4288 (V2 higher).
Cold start, sparse users (n=13, small sample - indicative only): NDCG@10 V2 0.2855 vs POPULARITY 0.4069 (POPULARITY higher).
Acceptance PASSED - V2 may become the production default.
